dataset_metadata.description: The EDGAR-CORPUS Financial Summarization dataset is derived from annual reports (Form 10-K) filed by publicly traded companies with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). It focuses on pairing specific sections of these filings, such as 'Item 7: Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A)', with expert-written or highly condensed summaries to facilitate abstractive summarization in the financial domain.

schema_analysis.description: The source text containing a specific section from a 10-K filing, typically the MD&A section.
The ground-truth summary corresponding to the source report section, condensed for key financial insights.
The name of the source file or the accession number of the SEC filing.

structural_logic.relationships: The 'report' column provides the context and raw data, while the 'summary' column is the target output. The 'filename' acts as a metadata link to identify specific companies or filing years.
structural_logic.label_dynamics: High complexity and low compression ratio compared to news; the content is dense with quantitative data, fiscal dates, and legal caveats.
structural_logic.potential_bottlenecks: Financial texts often contain tables, numerical lists, and standardized legal boilerplate which may be difficult for models to summarize narratively. Significant document length requires long-context handling.
